pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped dark polygons with predominantly angular vertices and sharp edge gradients. The patches on the lower neck exhibit higher elongation compared to the more equilateral polygonal structures on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. The topological graph consists of narrow pathways with consistent pixel thickness across the flank, connecting at junction nodes of three to four intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Distinctive jagged mane silhouette along the neck and shoulder, characterized by a repetitive, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern with high frequency.
